## Arguments

What each argument does for this dataset, and the rule it follows for every dataset that takes it.

| Argument | For this dataset | For every dataset |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `symbols` | Stock tickers; leave it out for every ticker. | Massive's ticker for each symbol, spelled exactly as Massive spells it: `AAPL` or `BRK.B` for a stock, `O:SPY271217C00700000` (the OCC code) for an option, `I:SPX` for an index, `C:EURUSD` for a forex pair, `X:BTCUSD` for a crypto pair, and `ESZ6` for a future. Pass one symbol as text, several as a list, or a table with a `Symbol` column. A live table is followed: each symbol you add is read, and each one you delete stops being read. `last_by()`, `fetch()`, `history()`, and most polls also drop a deleted symbol's rows. `dm.ALL` reads every symbol, and leaving the argument out reads every record with no filter by symbol, where this dataset takes them. A misspelled symbol in text or a list raises `ValueError` at the call; by default, a misspelled row of a table is skipped and logged, and the table keeps running. `dm.canonical_symbol` converts other spellings to Massive's. A record that lists several symbols, such as a news article, appears once for each symbol you named that it lists. |
| `sort` | Any field of the rows, such as `"market_cap"`. | The field to order the rows by, named as Massive names it, such as `"ex_dividend_date"`. Where the endpoint allows, name several, separated by commas, each with an optional `.asc` or `.desc`: `"ticker,ex_dividend_date.desc"`. This page lists the values the dataset takes. |
| `order` | The direction of `sort`. | The direction of `sort`: `dm.Order.ASC` or `dm.Order.DESC`. |
| `limit` | The most rows to return, in total. | The most rows Massive returns for the whole request, across every symbol you name, kept in Massive's order: ask for newest first (`order=dm.Order.DESC`) to keep the latest. A symbol that comes first can use up the whole limit, so leave `limit` out when you need every row of each symbol. A `fetch()` that follows a table of symbols applies it to each symbol's request, and this dataset's own line says where else it applies to each symbol. |
| `filters` | Further endpoint parameters, such as `{"price_to_earnings_lt": 15}`. | Any other parameter Massive documents for this dataset, as a mapping from the parameter's name to its value, with each dot in the name written as `_`: Massive's `strike_price.gte` is `strike_price_gte`. This page lists the keys the dataset takes. A key it doesn't take, or one that has its own argument, such as `start`, raises `ValueError` naming the keys it does take. A date or time value takes ISO 8601 text, or any value `start` takes. |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `ticker`: "Stock ticker symbol for the company." | REST |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. | REST |
| `Price` | double | Stock price used in ratio calculations, typically the closing price for the given date. | REST |
| `AverageVolume` | double | Average trading volume over the last 30 trading days, providing context for liquidity. | REST |
| `Cash` | double | Cash ratio, calculated as cash and cash equivalents divided by current liabilities, measuring the most liquid form of liquidity coverage. | REST |
| `Cik` | String | Central Index Key (CIK) number assigned by the SEC to identify the company. | REST |
| `Date` | String | Date for which the ratios are calculated, representing the trading date with available price data. | REST |
| `Current` | double | Current ratio, calculated as total current assets divided by total current liabilities, measuring short-term liquidity. | REST |
| `DebtToEquity` | double | Debt-to-equity ratio, calculated as total debt (current debt plus long-term debt) divided by total shareholders' equity, measuring financial leverage. | REST |
| `DividendYield` | double | Dividend yield, calculated as annual dividends per share divided by stock price, measuring the income return on investment. | REST |
| `EarningsPerShare` | double | Earnings per share, calculated as trailing twelve months (TTM) net income available to common shareholders divided by point-in-time shares outstanding as of the price date, assuming all shares of other share classes are converted to this share class. This is not weighted average basic or diluted shares outstanding, so this value will not match the reported basic or diluted EPS on the income statements endpoint. | REST |
| `EnterpriseValue` | double | Enterprise value, calculated as market capitalization plus total debt minus cash and cash equivalents, representing total company value. | REST |
| `EvToEbitda` | double | Enterprise value to EBITDA ratio, calculated as enterprise value divided by EBITDA, measuring company valuation relative to earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization. | REST |
| `EvToSales` | double | Enterprise value to sales ratio, calculated as enterprise value divided by revenue, measuring company valuation relative to sales. | REST |
| `FreeCashFlow` | double | Free cash flow, calculated as operating cash flow minus capital expenditures (purchase of property, plant, and equipment). | REST |
| `MarketCap` | double | Market capitalization, calculated as stock price multiplied by total shares outstanding. | REST |
| `PriceToBook` | double | Price-to-book ratio, calculated as stock price divided by book value per share, comparing market value to book value. | REST |
| `PriceToCashFlow` | double | Price-to-cash-flow ratio, calculated as stock price divided by operating cash flow per share. Only calculated when operating cash flow per share is positive. | REST |
| `PriceToEarnings` | double | Price-to-earnings ratio, calculated as stock price divided by earnings per share. Only calculated when earnings per share is positive. | REST |
| `PriceToFreeCashFlow` | double | Price-to-free-cash-flow ratio, calculated as stock price divided by free cash flow per share. Only calculated when free cash flow per share is positive. | REST |
| `PriceToSales` | double | Price-to-sales ratio, calculated as stock price divided by revenue per share, measuring valuation relative to sales. | REST |
| `Quick` | double | Quick ratio (acid-test ratio), calculated as (current assets minus inventories) divided by current liabilities, measuring immediate liquidity. | REST |
| `ReturnOnAssets` | double | Return on assets ratio, calculated as net income divided by total assets, measuring how efficiently a company uses its assets to generate profit. | REST |
| `ReturnOnEquity` | double | Return on equity ratio, calculated as net income divided by total shareholders' equity, measuring profitability relative to shareholders' equity. | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |
